requirements_summary:
SMB fintech (YC-style) looking to start on Redwood Hosted API.
Must-haves: SOC2 summary + SSO (SAML) guide, clear token/key rotation docs, audit logging visibility for admin users.
Nice-to-haves: VPC onboarding path (timeline & cost), quantization/instance recommendations for cost control, per-route token cost breakdowns.
POC scope: 1) embeddings for customer doc search, 2) support chat assistant with canned fallbacks, 3) lightweight reranker for fraud signal prioritization.
Acceptance criteria: embeddings MRR recall > 0.82 on seed test set, chat median latency <200ms under typical load, security signoff on SOC2 summary.
